title: Bugs Hungry for Blood Hide in my Writing haunts not sure if I should bat way metaphors of deeper meaning or write shorter poems #smallpoems
summary: Bugs Hungry for Blood Hide in my Writing haunts not sure if I should bat way metaphors of deeper meaning or write shorter poems #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bugs
Hungry
   for Blood
Hide in my
  Writing haunts
  not sure
if I should bat way
  metaphors of
deeper meaning
  or write shorter
poems
#smallpoems
